scope: Measurements adjacent to the FR-31 model for a protein-free DOPC bilayer. The three assays measure different observables.

studies.locator: Figure 4, Table 1 and the pure-DOPC results
studies.observable: Local rotational microviscosity from solvent-calibrated DCVJ fluorescence brightness in DOPC vesicles.
studies.limit: Probe rotation senses its local surroundings. The conversion to the in-plane shear viscosity used for pore friction is unresolved.

studies.locator: Figure 5B, Eq. 2, SI Table S4 and the neutron spin echo methods
studies.observable: In-plane viscosity inferred from nanoscale thickness fluctuations of tail-deuterated DOPC vesicles in D₂O at zero cholesterol.
studies.limit: One temperature and a fitted fluctuation model. Transferring this viscosity to the friction of a critical pore requires a physical assumption.

studies.locator: Table 1 and the pure-DOPC pore-closure results
studies.observable: Shrinkage and closure after an electrical pulse in free DOPC vesicles. Edge tension was inferred from the shrinking pore.
studies.limit: Tension can relax after the pulse. This assay supplies neither the probability of reclosure during a constant-tension hold nor separate opening and release heats.
